title: The Story about the Lost Button
youtube_title: The Story about the Lost Button | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Listening all the way through is a gift you can give today.
summary: At a kitchen table before breakfast, chairs close, Mama begins to tell Nils about a long story about a lost button that was not lost anymore. Nils wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
